It's time to learn how to fish.  Really learn. 

 

Baxstar Fishing lessons are guaranteed to improve your angling skills.  Brady has been a teacher for 14 years, and he is a volunteer boat captain for the Detroit Lakes Fishing team.  He will use his teaching skills to help you learn how to fish.  A few hours with Brady can change the way you fish forever.

Individual and group lessons are available and all ages are welcome.  Lessons are conducted from shore, in Brady's Boat, or in the comfort of your own boat.  Ice fishing lessons also available.  You can choose the time and place, or Brady will help you select the location that is right for your needs.
